text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock B and C only when they were above my average cost, which may reflect my reluctance to realize losses rather than a sound forward-looking decision.","Taking gains felt satisfying, but selling winners in small amounts without a clear portfolio plan may have reduced my ability to stay invested in them.","My account value fell over these periods despite realizing gains, so I should judge decisions by overall risk, diversification, and future prospects—not by whether a position shows a gain or loss."]}
